verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is an open-source, self-hosted library with no paywall (crawl4ai-docs-4), but it still routes through paid proxies and LLMs, so budget controls are a fair axis for a scraping tool. The evidence shows page-count limits (--max-pages), adaptive stopping, and a system-metrics dashboard. None of these is a spending cap or usage alert on proxy or LLM consumption, so nothing in the pack delivers the story.
